needed_lemma: A uniform near-p=1 approximation of the directed Bernoulli max-flow/min-cut by the rescaled Poisson/Hammersley process, with control strong enough to identify the coefficient sqrt(2(1-p)).
unproved_interface: Aldous's web note supplies the conjecture and identifies the limit-interchange obstruction. Aldous–Diaconis Theorem 5 proves the continuum Poisson LIS constant c=2; Dilworth gives the same constant for the minimum continuum monotone point-chain cover. Still missing: a uniform, p-dependent comparison from the discrete Bernoulli closed-edge cover with edge-disjoint paths to that continuum cover, including boundary/discretization errors strong enough to exchange n→∞ and p↑1. Cerf–Théret is only an undirected max-flow comparator; MATLAB enumerations are finite-volume evidence.

needed_lemma: A nondegenerate i.i.d. undirected edge-weight law on a specified lattice with a rigorously explicit axial time constant.
unproved_interface: The read survey W06-001 distinguishes existence of the shape/time-constant norm from computing an explicit nondegenerate axial value. W06-035 and W06-037 remain unread candidates and are not evidence in this mapping.

needed_lemma: Rule out any flat boundary segment outside the oriented-percolation cone for the exact Mp law class in the archive.
unproved_interface: Auffinger–Damron prove differentiability at flat-edge endpoints under the minimum-atom/oriented-percolation hypotheses and non-polygonality; endpoint differentiability is not strict convexity or absence of other flat edges.

needed_lemma: Establish the archived fluctuation-exponent assertions for the stated non-integrable FPP laws, including existence of the exponents under the source definition.
unproved_interface: The cited variance/concentration bounds and conditional scaling relation do not prove chi<1/2 or chi=1/3 for ordinary undirected FPP. The planar midpoint/influence bound in W06-028 is auxiliary and does not establish a polynomial variance exponent or the archived exponent existence claim.

needed_lemma: A dimension-uniform argument establishing whether chi(d) tends to zero, conditional on existence in the exact source sense.
unproved_interface: The survey records this as an open question; no read source here supplies the dimension-dependent exponent.

needed_lemma: A polynomial-scale fluctuation lower bound sufficient for strict positivity of the exponent under the archived assumptions.
unproved_interface: Newman–Piza logarithmic variance lower bounds are far below a positive power; general sublinear-variance upper bounds do not imply lower fluctuation exponents.

needed_lemma: Prove equality of chi_2 and chi_(2+delta) for some delta>0 using the exact moment-scaled exponent definitions in the survey.
unproved_interface: The sources provide concentration, variance, or a conditional chi–xi relation; none establishes the required equality between moment-based fluctuation exponents.

needed_lemma: For 3D Bernoulli edge weights with P(tau=0)=p_c(3), obtain matching logarithmic bounds for E T(0,partial B(n)).
unproved_interface: The fully read invasion/RSW theorem is for 2D square lattice; the other critical source is 2D triangular lattice. Neither transfers to 3D.

needed_lemma: Determine the largest cylinder-width exponent gamma_F(d) for which the normalized passage time still has a Gaussian limit, preserving the source moment and geometry hypotheses.
unproved_interface: The source poses the optimal-width question; the known sufficient width and a conditional extension under fluctuation/curvature assumptions do not identify the general maximum.

needed_lemma: Show the infimum passage time is attained by a finite path for all pairs in d>=3 for arbitrary finite nonnegative i.i.d. weights, including critical zero clusters.
unproved_interface: Known geodesic existence results require dimension/law conditions or concern planar subsets; they leave the critical zero-cluster case in higher dimensions open.

needed_lemma: Construct an undirected i.i.d. lattice-FPP law satisfying every clause of the strong exponent definition (4.19) in the source survey.
unproved_interface: Integrable directed LPP/KPZ exponents are different models. The conditional KPZ relation alone cannot produce an undirected FPP example meeting all clauses of (4.19). W06-036 remains an unread candidate and is not part of the verified evidence route.

needed_lemma: For each deterministic direction θ fixed in advance, prove almost-sure uniqueness of the directed ray from each fixed starting point in the archived planar continuous-weight setup, extending the result from a deterministic full-Lebesgue-measure set D to every θ individually. The probability-one event may depend on θ (and the fixed starting point); the target is not one common event for all directions.
unproved_interface: Theorem 4.20 in the survey gives a deterministic full-measure direction set D for each fixed starting point, and C097 asks whether D can be all [0,2π), meaning P(Aθ)=1 for each fixed deterministic θ. This is distinct from P(Aθ for every θ)=1, which the archived question does not ask. Directed LPP and half-plane/subgraph results do not prove the undirected full-plane per-direction extension.

needed_lemma: Extend the source same-direction coalescence conclusion from d=2 to the stated d>2 setting while preserving the continuity and ray-direction hypotheses.
unproved_interface: Available coalescence inputs here use planar ordering or directed LPP structure; higher-dimensional topology is not supplied.

needed_lemma: Determine growth of the count of edges at radius r used by infinitely many selected point-to-point geodesics, with the archive construction and quantifiers.
unproved_interface: A planar expected covered-area bound under additional assumptions is not the requested edge-count growth law for the Hammersley–Welsh tree.

needed_lemma: For every d>=2, compare exponential-FPP axial and equal-Euclidean-distance diagonal speeds strictly.
unproved_interface: C100 is i.i.d. exponential edge-weight FPP / edge-clock growth. The 2011 CEG paper states a d≥35 non-ball corollary (its displayed numerical comparison is at d=35); Bertrand–Pertinand Theorem 1 directly proves the strict axis/diagonal comparison at d=22. Do not infer d≥22 from that single-d theorem. The survey Question 33 uses exponential vertex weights and uniform choice among distinct frontier vertices, so that passage is not evidence for this edge-FPP archive. The cited/read results here do not resolve dimensions 2–21 of the archived statement; this is a boundary of this evidence set, not a claim about current global open status.

needed_lemma: Show that two finite seeds cannot both occupy infinitely many sites for every pair of distinct positive growth rates in the stated two-type lattice model.
unproved_interface: The survey reports an all-but-countably-many parameter result and leaves the exceptional rates. Hoffman stationary FPP theorem concerns same-environment coexistence and does not settle unequal rates.

needed_lemma: Prove monotonicity in lambda_2 of the coexistence probability for the exact lattice Richardson process and parameter interval in the archive.
unproved_interface: The survey formulates the monotonicity question and notes counterexamples on other graphs; the same-rate coexistence theorem does not prove this coupling monotonicity.
